page.overview:
Who is Master Hwang?

Master Hwang was a minor character who appeared in the Mortal Kombat: Conquest series in the episode entitled “Immortal Kombat”. He was prtrayed by Atilano Bernardo David.

Master Hwang was an elderly monk who served in the Temple of the Order of Light. Kung Lao took Siro and Taja to the temple for some meditation and reflection. What Siro and Taja discover after some reflection is that this isn’t for them and they decide to leave Kung Lao and head back to the trading post.

As they were leaving the temple, Master Hwang notices a water sack hanging on a post, assuming it belongs to the duo, he runs to catch up and give it to them, eventually leaving it with Siro. Hwang also drank some of the water before he gave it to them. The sack, as it turns out, is Kung Lao’s, but his friends took it anyway.

Hwang returned to the Temple and died shortly thereafter. As the other monks were preparing his body for burial, it continued to age and disintegrate, until there is nothing left except a pile of dust. It was clear to the other monks, such as Master Jai, that dark powers of sorcery were at work.
